ml-engineer.name: ML Engineer Build
ml-engineer.tagline: You own the pipeline. The pipeline knows.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience
3+ years of experience building, deploying, and maintaining machine learning models in production environments
Strong Python programming skills and proficiency with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerized deployment using Docker or Kubernetes
Experience designing scalable data and ML pipelines, including distributed training and model serving at scale

deep-learning-engineer.name: Deep Learning Engineer Build
requirements: 3+ years writing and optimizing GPU kernels in CUDA, Triton, or CUTLASS for production ML systems
Deep knowledge of GPU architecture, including memory hierarchy, warps, Tensor Cores, and kernel fusion
Hands-on experience with large-scale distributed training using FSDP, DeepSpeed, or Megatron-style parallelism
Strong proficiency in Python and C++, plus PyTorch or JAX internals such as torch.compile or XLA
Experience profiling and removing performance bottlenecks with Nsight, including NCCL collective communication tuning

llm-engineer.name: LLM Engineer Build
requirements: 3+ years of software or ML engineering experience building and deploying production systems in Python
Hands-on experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs with PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and PEFT methods such as LoRA
Experience building RAG pipelines with embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, reranking, and vector databases like Pinecone or Weaviate
Experience designing evaluation harnesses and benchmarks for LLM quality using frameworks such as LangSmith or Promptfoo
Familiarity with LLM inference serving and optimization using vLLM, TensorRT, or Ray, plus provider APIs like OpenAI and Anthropic

forward-deployed-engineer.name: Forward Deployed Build
forward-deployed-engineer.tagline: Consultant, PM, and engineer. Hydration for all three.
requirements: 3+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems
Proficiency in Python and JavaScript or TypeScript, including full-stack application development
Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs, building RAG pipelines, and evaluating model outputs
Experience in customer-facing technical work such as pilots, demos, and enterprise integrations
Ability to travel to and embed with customers, translating business requirements into deployed solutions

research-scientist.name: Research Scientist Build
requirements: PhD in computer science, machine learning, statistics, or related field, or equivalent research experience
First-author publications at top venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or CVPR
Strong proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX
2+ years of experience designing, training, and evaluating deep learning models at scale
Solid grounding in ML mathematics, experimental design, and empirical analysis of model behavior

mlops-engineer.name: MLOps Build
mlops-engineer.tagline: Uptime for the humans who keep uptime.
requirements: 3+ years of experience in MLOps, DevOps, or ML infrastructure engineering roles
Strong Python proficiency and experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
Hands-on experience deploying and serving models on AWS, GCP, or Azure, such as SageMaker or Vertex AI
Experience building CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code with tools like Terraform, Ansible, or Helm
Working knowledge of ML lifecycle tooling such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or similar experiment tracking and model registry systems

data-engineer.name: Data Engineer Build
requirements: 3+ years of professional experience building and maintaining production data pipelines as a data engineer
Strong proficiency in SQL and Python for data modeling, transformation, and pipeline development
Experience with distributed processing frameworks such as Apache Spark, Hadoop, or Flink
Hands-on experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect, plus dbt
Experience with cloud data warehouses and platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or AWS
